item.text: {"summary":"The target contract and forecast fields are coherent, but the prior sample, model treatment, and +0.15-point update need clearer support.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"base_rate","severity":"warning","summary":"The six-observation prior includes December 2025 at 0.0%, but that observation is absent from historicalContext and lacks a cited archived release.","actionRequested":"Cite and list the December first print, or recompute the prior and volatility from the five documented observations."},{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"warning","summary":"No distinct time-series/model prior is used or explicitly ruled out; the reference-class median is only labeled a persistence prior.","actionRequested":"State why a more formal time-series model is unsuitable for this short, noisy sample, or provide its estimate separately."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The +0.15-point adjustment relies mainly on anticipated CPI normalization and nominal wage persistence, while the real-earnings base rate already embeds typical wage growth and no current July CPI evidence is available.","actionRequested":"Decompose the adjustment without double-counting embedded nominal-wage behavior and justify its magnitude using cited pre-forecast evidence; otherwise shrink it toward the prior."},{"rubricItem":"prior_update_interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The compact calculation depends on the undocumented December observation and combines two update mechanisms into one judgmental increment.","actionRequested":"Use a fully cited historical sample and itemize the numerical contribution of each adjustment component."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify that nominal wage growth minus CPI-U inflation is an approximation to the BLS index calculation.","Add the December archived BLS URL if retaining the six-print sample."]}
